verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents transaction rules that automatically approve or decline card authorizations when they don't meet configured business requirements, plus configurable fallback logic (default approve/refuse) for relayed authorisation timeouts. This is a genuine, product-native rules-to-action mechanism, but it covers only authorization events and approve/decline outcomes, not general event-triggered automation. Missing for 10: rules triggered by other events (disputes, balance changes, card lifecycle), actions beyond approve/decline (e.g., suspend card, notify), detailed rule-definition docs (conditions, scopes), independent or hands-on corroboration.
